correctness.rationale: All facet and root vertices are read from actual pinned RESULT.md. The edge criterion v.w=1 follows from an exposing functional and midpoint nonedge constructions for d>=4. The sign pattern of u.v is fixed on each signed coordinate chamber when |u_i| distinct, so cut-edge and crossed-facet incidences are fixed. Counting crossings from positive roots q_ij^± gives the cubic vertex formula; deleting two coordinate facets and four signed facets from the 2d+2^d full facet families gives the exponential formula. An independent exact combinatorial enumeration reconstructed root vertices, crossing edges and facet cut-incidences for d=4..7: (f0,facets)=(32,18),(80,36),(160,70),(280,136), and d=4 six 4-gons/twelve 6-gons. Enumeration is corroboration only; the chamber/crossing proof applies to every dimension and every stated normal.

value.rationale: The D_d root polytopes are a classical infinite crystallographic family; generic central section incidence is a natural difficult-to-enumerate invariant. The result supplies a uniform all-d combinatorial rigidity theorem and two exact face-number laws beyond the already-known D4 case, useful for further study of root-polytope sections and oriented matroids. Not merely a renamed D4 enumeration.

final_claim: For all d>=4 the type-D root-polytope generic central hyperplane section has a single face lattice, f0=4d(d-1)(d-2)/3, f_{d-2}=2^d+2d-6; d=4 has 32 vertices and 6 quadrilateral plus 12 hexagonal facets.
